parameters.description:
`mailgun-email-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `mailgun_email` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Mailgun URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters (the `api_key_secret` parameter names the customer secret holding this enrollment's base64 of user:password for HTTP basic auth).
parameters.summary: Relay an email through your own Mailgun account by posting a native `mailgun_email` payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's base64 of user:password for HTTP basic auth

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's MAILGUN_EMAIL_HOST value (same format as MAILGUN_EMAIL_HOST)
